changes.title: Bald Range Wildfire Forces Evacuation of 18,000 in British Columbia
changes.summary: The Bald Range fire has burned more than 25,000 acres in British Columbia. At one point, the fire spread more than 2,000 acres in about an hour, officials said.

changes.summary: British Columbia declared a state of emergency Saturday after a fast-moving wildfire destroyed homes and forced more than 20,000 people to flee their communities.

changes.title: Wildfire Forces Evacuation of 18,000 From Summerland, British Columbia
changes.summary: The Bald Range fire, which started on Friday, has burned more than 23,000 acres near the Districts of Summerland and Peachland in British Columbia, officials said.
